name: La Sayona
scope: Dedicated La Sayona audit using preserved folklore dossier, real shared-engine fights, and an independently opened native T3 preview tab. Only this report and tests/character-audits/sayona.test.ts were written in the repository. No runtime or art edits, commits, servers, or child agents.

identityAndPortrayal.preservedDossier: The folklore dossier explicitly defines the red shawl and feline gaze as this arcade adaptation. Existing red/black dress, long dark hair, red shawl, and spectral short displacement are consistent with that preserved brief. No new historical claims or broad web research were introduced.

sourceReference.title: La Sayona — tradición y variantes
sourceReference.verification: Preserved dossier reference, not independently browsed in this focused audit.

identityAndPortrayal.visualMatch: The eight inspected combat poses preserve the same woman, red shawl and dark dress. Light uses a forward claw-like hand and heavy a high kick. Likeness and costume remained consistent across both facings.

movementAndStance.jump: Both sides accept a first and second jump, reject a third, and land at floor y554 with grounded=true, jumps=0 and both stocks. First jump y454.6 at call10.
movementAndStance.visualObservation: Native production drawSprite renders all eight complete poses facing right and left: ready0, guard1, run2/3, tucked jump4, hand attack5, kick6 and recoil7. Heads, hands, boots and skirt silhouettes are intact; no reverse-facing pose, clipped limb, or borrowed neighboring fragment was observed.

special.name: Paso espectral
special.distinctBehavior: One instantaneous directional short blink at attackTick12 followed by one melee collision check. No projectile, multi-pulse, or continued dash. Displacement is min(210,max(0,absolute rival gap-86)), then clamped to x70..1010.

idle.postRecovery: Attacker holds the blink destination through call97 and returns to no attack; no repeat damage.

special.frontGuard: At gap280 on both sides, holding block toward La Sayona records exactly one block, leaves target HP100 and attacker hits0.
special.rearGuard: At gap280, hold block plus away-direction movement. Both sides take one14.6775-damage hit and no block. Defender movement increases the blink to208.5629826697438 units by activation; it remains below210.
special.energyGate: Energy24 rejects the special; energy25 allows it. At energy100, activation leaves75 before later regeneration or hit rewards. Checked both player sides.

rangeProbes.result: All predictions pass on both sides. Gap329 leaves119 and hits; gap330 leaves120 and misses because melee reach is strict.

special.directionalCollision: Both sides start airborne at y500 to preserve an intentionally reversed facing when beginning special. A rival80 units behind causes zero blink and zero hit despite being inside absolute melee range; a rival300 units behind causes a blink away limited by the stage edge, with zero hit. Facing stays locked during the special.
special.stageClamp: Airborne facing-away probes start P1 x980/rival710/facing+1 and P2 x100/rival370/facing-1. At call12, x clamps to1010 and70 respectively; neither hits the rear rival.

invulnerability.setup: Both sides start gap500; special begins at call1 and blinks at call12. Rival is then placed80 units ahead and uses its real light action through shared/engine.ts.
invulnerability.immuneProbe: Rival light starts call13 and contacts call18: La Sayona HP100, rival hits0, remaining blink invincibility1.
invulnerability.expiryProbe: Rival light starts call14 and contacts call19: La Sayona HP92.9384, rival hits1, special interrupted. Blink invincibility has expired; normal hit invincibility becomes12.
invulnerability.hitstopInterpretation: The seven frames are simulation frames. Hitstop freezes attack ticks and invincibility timers; wall-clock input calls can therefore exceed seven during an actual blink hit.

attacksAndCombos.light: At gap80 on each side, connects once for6.8495 damage, pushes outward and does not repeat; front guard prevents HP loss.
attacksAndCombos.heavy: At gap80 on each side, connects once for12.7205 damage, pushes outward and does not repeat; front guard prevents HP loss.
attacksAndCombos.baseCombo: Sombra roja (light→heavy), bonus3, connects both hits with chase inputs on both sides; target HP77.34 after63 simulation ticks.
attacksAndCombos.advancedCombo: Aparición doble (light→light→heavy), bonus7 at one win, connects all three hits with chase inputs on both sides; target HP66.3705 after104 simulation ticks. At zero wins the same input history stays Sombra roja with bonus3.
attacksAndCombos.inputHistory: Separate gap140 recognition probes deliberately whiff the initial lights; the heavy still receives the input-chain combo bonus. This is the existing input-chain design. Connected-combo tests independently prove every intended strike can land.
attacksAndCombos.super: Última visita requires three wins and75 energy. Zero/two wins or74 energy reject it. With three wins and100 energy at gap200, startup9 hits once for39.758 damage, leaving target HP60.242 on both sides.

cpuFight.method: Run the full510-tick shared intro, idle180 input calls to exercise CPU offense, then chase, block, jump and choose ordinary attacks/special/super. Replay independently and compare the full final state.
cpuFight.limitation: This deterministic exercised bout is not a balance benchmark. Dedicated tests verify light damage even though light did not connect during this complete bout.

introAndSelection.introName: Revela la mirada bajo el mantón
introAndSelection.method: Directly import production loadSprite/drawSprite/drawPresentation/drawIntroCinematic and shared engine inside own native tab. Ephemeral canvases only; no repository visual harness. Use Sayona on both sides in the cinematic to inspect the side-specific timing.
introAndSelection.observation: She parts the shawl and reveals her gaze once, then releases to the ready pose. Both mirrored faces look inward toward the rival in the cinematic. The restrained spectral/selection accents disappear at the final ready pose.
introAndSelection.oneShot: selectionProgress reaches1 at2800ms and remains1 at5600ms. Production selection render pixel hashes are identical at those elapsed times in both facings: right2040014085/2040014085; left3426299433/3426299433. Engine movement and special input remain gated until all510 intro ticks complete.
introAndSelection.environment: Initial preview_status had no tab; a new native tab opened successfully with reuseExistingTab=false. Earlier development hot reloads and WebSocket warnings appeared in the console; controlled imported-renderer checks completed successfully. No new browser system or server was started.
introAndSelection.limitations: Representative static animation samples were inspected, not every interpolation frame. Audio listening and audiovisual synchronization were not audited.

recommendation: Retain La Sayona behavior and current arcade art; this focused audit found no reproducible character-specific defect requiring a runtime edit.

verification.freshProcessRetest: Reran the dedicated tsx test after final probe adjustments and after the native visual checks;10/10 passed. Repository TypeScript check also passed after those adjustments.
